description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different multilingual BERT models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) on various Indo-European language families (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic) in terms of their morphosyntactic probing capabilities. The vertical axis represents the effect, measured in a numerical scale, while the horizontal axis lists the Indo-European language families. Each bar represents the effect of a model on a specific language family, with different colors indicating different models. The bars vary in height, indicating the varying effects of the models on the language families, with some models showing a higher effect and others a lower effect. The chart includes error bars, suggesting variability or confidence intervals around the effect measurements.
